full_page.content:
1947, May 6
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap. (from the photo copy)
May 6th, 1947
Miss Doris Panyard, Muskegan, Michigan
Praise the Lord in all His designs
God bless you Miss Panyard -- you and yours. MANY THANKS
Congratulations on your Birth-day -- another year's service in the good God's wonderful universe.
I meant to call you up last night the first I knew it was so late that I just decided not to call. I do hope that you enjoyed the day and especially with the folks last night. . . . . Jerry called me from Notre Dame but I rather fear I was a disapointment. I did what I think was best under circumstances. I am glad he caled. Some day --- God willing -- things will be different.
Praised be Jesus! Fr. Solanus, O. F. M. Cap. P. S. God's blessing to all the Family.
Original in possession of: Doris Panyard 3248 Maple Grove Rd. Apt. 37 Muskegon, Mich.4944 1
